en:
## New Features

- Plugin providers: plugins can now register as model providers, with an RPC contract, generated config forms, a custom settings surface and an encrypted secret vault for their credentials
- Knowledge base: personal libraries that shadow the global entry, a submit/review/publish flow with withdraw and resubmit, graded authorization by clearance level and controlled tags, bulk grants, ownership transfer and entry-to-entry links
- Export a narrator transcript to Markdown or JSON, choosing full or visible history and whether to include tool input/output
- Priority (fast) mode is now a per-session setting with a global default that sessions can inherit
- Permission rules can target a specific remote device, with a path picker that browses the device's filesystem and explicit POSIX/Windows path handling
- Migrate narrators pinned to a model that can no longer run — scan for them, pick a replacement, and undo the migration if needed
- OAuth applications can be exported and imported as JSON, with per-app policies for remote shell, remote file writes and device access
- Turn-level token usage, user message markers and a jump-to-message action in the virtual message list

## Bug Fixes

- A narrator-scoped rollback no longer destroys work another narrator, a subagent or your editor wrote between its tool calls: the window is now reversed segment by segment, and non-tail rollbacks keep later work instead of collapsing it
- Rollbacks silently failed to delete files whose names contain non-ASCII characters
- The revert button was permanently disabled for workspaces without tree snapshots, even though that rollback works
- Batch block deletion no longer leaves changes on disk with the history describing them deleted; a shared message's tool boundary is preserved for other narrators
- Single-instance guard: two processes starting at once could both take the lock and run side by side; on Windows the guard never engaged at all
- A destructive migration whose data copy failed could leave an empty table instead of stopping
- Transcript export and the storage scan gained hard ceilings, so a large history or deep directory tree can no longer stall the server
- Credential plaintext is no longer readable by non-admin users through a plugin's settings panel
- Remote directory listing through a narrator no longer exposes paths the caller cannot otherwise reach
- Cancelling a file transfer now cleans up its partial files instead of leaving them behind
- Built-in gateway credential files are written atomically with 0600 permissions, and already-deployed files are repaired
- A failed permission-policy compile no longer denies every later tool call for that narrator
- Storage scanning skips symlinks instead of recursing through cycles
- The resolved ask-in-passing card and the code copy button are now keyboard accessible
- Pinch-zoom no longer fights the page on touch devices

## Refactoring

- The built-in gateway chat protocol moved into a shared module so one copy serves both the built-in channel and bundled plugin code
- Permission evaluation moved onto a dedicated execution-policy engine
- Workspace snapshots use git tree objects in a shadow repository, making a revert a single read-tree plus checkout-index
- Fork message references are created lazily and backfilled on demand
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 插件提供商：插件现在可以注册为模型提供商，包含 RPC 契约、自动生成的配置表单、自定义设置界面，以及用于存放凭证的加密保险库
- 知识库：个人库可覆盖全局条目，新增提交/评审/发布流程（支持撤回与重新提交）、按密级和受控标签的分级授权、批量授权、所有权转移，以及条目间关联
- 支持将叙述者会话导出为 Markdown 或 JSON，可选择完整或可见历史，以及是否包含工具输入输出
- 优先模式（fast mode）改为按会话设置，并提供可被会话继承的全局默认值
- 权限规则可指定远程设备，配套的路径选择器能直接浏览设备文件系统，并显式区分 POSIX 与 Windows 路径
- 迁移绑定了已无法使用模型的叙述者：可扫描、选择替代模型并支持撤销迁移
- OAuth 应用支持 JSON 导出导入，并可按应用配置远程 shell、远程文件写入和设备访问策略
- 虚拟消息列表新增按轮次的 token 用量、用户消息标记和跳转到消息

## 修复

- 叙述者范围的回退不再破坏其他叙述者、子代理或你的编辑器在其工具调用之间写入的内容：回退窗口现在按段逐一反转，非末尾回退会保留后续工作而不是一并抹掉
- 修复文件名含非 ASCII 字符时回退静默删除失败的问题
- 修复没有 tree 快照的工作区回退按钮被永久禁用的问题（该回退本身可用）
- 批量删除消息块不再出现「改动留在磁盘上、描述它的历史却已删除」；共享消息的工具边界会为其他叙述者保留
- 单实例守卫：两个进程同时启动可能都拿到锁并并行运行；Windows 上该守卫此前完全不生效
- 破坏性迁移在数据复制失败时可能留下空表，现在会中止而非继续
- 会话导出和存储扫描增加了硬上限，超大历史或极深目录树不会再让服务器卡住
- 非管理员用户不再能通过插件设置面板读取凭证明文
- 通过叙述者浏览远程目录不再暴露调用者本无权访问的路径
- 取消文件传输现在会清理残留的分片文件
- 内置网关凭证文件改为 0600 权限原子写入，并修复已部署文件的权限
- 权限策略编译失败不再导致该叙述者后续所有工具调用被拒绝
- 存储扫描跳过符号链接，不再在环形链接中无限递归
- 顺路提问的已解决卡片和代码复制按钮现在支持键盘操作
- 修复触摸设备上双指缩放与页面冲突的问题

## 重构

- 内置网关聊天协议移入共享模块，内置通道与插件打包代码共用同一份实现
- 权限判定迁移到独立的执行策略引擎
- 工作区快照改用影子仓库中的 git tree 对象，回退变成一次 read-tree 加 checkout-index
- 分叉的消息引用改为惰性创建、按需回填
